text: Employees receive 24 days of paid leave per calendar year. Leave requests should be submitted through the employee portal before the leave begins.
Employees work from the office on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. Monday and Friday are optional work-from-home days.
Employees can claim up to Rs 3000 per month for gym or fitness membership reimbursement by submitting valid receipts.
Employees can claim up to Rs 2000 per month for home internet reimbursement by submitting the monthly internet bill.
Employees have a 90-day notice period when resigning from the company.
The company provides health insurance coverage for the employee and eligible dependents. Coverage details are available in the benefits portal.
Eligible employees may take 16 weeks of paid parental leave after the birth or adoption of a child.
Every employee receives an annual learning budget of Rs 25000 for approved courses, books, and conferences.
